metadata.title: Cybersecurity Standards for Cloud Systems — High Impact, Cloud Service Provider

prop.name: certification
prop.value: Certified by a certify body on a 3-year cycle. This includes a full certification in the 1st year and a surveillance audit in the 2nd and 3rd years. Additionally, it must also be certified to either ISO/IEC 27017 or CSA STAR Level 2/CCM, and ISO/IEC 27018 and ISO/IEC 27701.

remarks.p: High Impact baseline for a Cloud Service Provider (CSP), from the minimum-requirements matrix in clause 4 of the annex.
Selects 37 of the catalog's 37 cloud service provider controls, of which 10 are added at this level (5.2.5, 5.2.6) over the moderate-impact profile.
Minimum requirements as the matrix states them: Part One: - All Part Two: - All

Certification required of the cloud service provider at this level: Certified by a certify body on a 3-year cycle. This includes a full certification in the 1st year and a surveillance audit in the 2nd and 3rd years. Additionally, it must also be certified to either ISO/IEC 27017 or CSA STAR Level 2/CCM, and ISO/IEC 27018 and ISO/IEC 27701.
This profile is a rendering of a published standard and carries no roles or parties: the National Cyber Security Committee issued the standard, not this file.
